$comment: Booking calendar (client feedback, 12 Nov 2026): the season and the lesson times of each day, set by the tide. days: { "YYYY-MM-DD": { "slots": ["HH:MM", ...], "low": "HH:MM", "high": "HH:MM", "closed": true } } — all keys optional.
